You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 6 of 50 (script duration 115.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
E3: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
E4: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
E5: Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.
Direct lead-in to E6: Picks up immediately from Episode 5, as Juliana and her mysterious new husband leave the Ashcroft estate behind and venture out into the rainy countryside.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.3] SCREEN: Medium full tracking shot of Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man trudging along a muddy, rain-soaked path in the dark woods.
[L002 0.0-3.4] ACTION: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
[L003 2.3-3.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.
[L004 2.3-6.5] SFX: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
[L005 3.5-4.2] SCREEN: Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.
[L006 4.2-7.1] SCREEN: Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.
[L007 4.5-7.1] ACTION: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
[L008 7.1-9.9] SCREEN: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.
[L009 7.2-9.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn, Gentle): "I know this is not the life you came from."
[L010 9.9-14.9] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.
[L011 10.1-11.2] JULIANA (Quiet, Melancholic): "No."
[L012 11.3-13.0] ACTION: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.
[L013 13.4-14.6] JULIANA (Resigned, Soft): "It isn't."
[L014 14.9-17.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.
[L015 15.2-18.2] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Guilt-ridden): "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."
[L016 17.2-18.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.
[L017 18.3-21.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.
[L018 18.5-20.9] JULIANA (Faintly Ironic, Resilient): "I suppose the day was already ruined."
[L019 21.0-24.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.
[L020 24.0-26.1] SCREEN: Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.
[L021 24.5-26.1] ACTION: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
[L022 26.1-27.9] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.
[L023 26.5-27.7] JULIANA (Surprised, Hesitant): "That is it?"
[L024 27.9-29.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.
[L025 28.1-29.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low): "Yes."
[L026 29.2-30.1] SCREEN: Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.
[L027 29.2-30.5] SFX: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
[L028 30.1-33.0] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.
[L029 30.1-33.1] JULIANA (Determined, Defiant): "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
[L030 33.0-33.7] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.
[L031 33.7-36.7] ACTION: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
[L032 33.8-36.5] SFX: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
[L033 36.7-37.7] SCREEN: Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
[L034 36.7-40.0] SFX: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
[L035 37.7-40.0] SCREEN: Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.
[L036 40.0-42.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.
[L037 40.7-41.9] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Humble, Apologetic): "I am sorry."
[L038 42.0-43.3] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
[L039 43.3-46.4] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.
[L040 43.6-45.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere): "You came from comfort."
[L041 45.1-47.3] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere): "This is all I can give you now."
[L042 46.4-48.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
[L043 46.6-49.0] ACTION: Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
[L044 48.8-51.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
[L045 51.1-54.8] SCREEN: Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.
[L046 51.3-52.7] JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful): "It is quiet."
[L047 53.3-54.6] JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful): "Very quiet."
[L048 54.8-56.2] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.
[L049 56.2-58.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.
[L050 56.4-58.0] JULIANA (Earnest, Content): "I think I like that."
[L051 58.2-59.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.
[L052 58.4-60.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Incredulous): "You are not disappointed?"
[L053 59.8-61.3] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.
[L054 60.3-61.3] JULIANA (Direct, Soft): "I am."
[L055 61.3-64.1] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.
[L056 61.9-64.1] JULIANA (Warm, Reassuring): "But not because of you."
[L057 64.1-66.6] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.
[L058 64.3-66.8] JULIANA (Determined, Practical): "If this is our home, I want it clean."
[L059 66.6-67.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.
[L060 66.7-68.7] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Caring, Tender): "You don't have to do that tonight."
[L061 67.8-69.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
[L062 69.5-72.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.
[L063 70.1-73.2] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling): "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[L064 72.1-74.3] SCREEN: Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.
[L065 74.3-76.8] ACTION: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[L066 74.3-76.8] SCREEN: Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.
[L067 76.8-77.8] ACTION: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[L068 76.8-77.8] SCREEN: Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
[L069 77.8-81.0] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[L070 77.8-81.0] SCREEN: Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
[L071 81.0-83.8] ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[L072 81.0-83.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
[L073 83.8-85.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
[L074 83.8-90.0] SFX: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[L075 85.0-87.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
[L076 87.5-89.8] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
[L077 87.5-89.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.
[L078 89.0-89.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved): "There."
[L079 89.8-91.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
[L080 91.7-93.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.
[L081 92.1-93.6] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest): "It is not much."
[L082 93.8-95.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.
[L083 94.2-96.2] JULIANA (Soft, Comforted): "It is enough for tonight."
[L084 95.8-98.2] SCREEN: Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
[L085 98.2-101.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.
[L086 98.4-100.4] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I lost my home today."
[L087 100.6-101.8] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "My family."
[L088 101.0-103.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.
[L089 102.0-104.8] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "Everything I thought my life would be."
[L090 103.0-104.3] SCREEN: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
[L091 104.3-106.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.
[L092 105.0-106.0] JULIANA (Gentle, Surprised): "And yet..."
[L093 106.0-109.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's profile, his scarred cheek illuminated by the amber glow as he watches over her protectively.
[L094 106.2-109.0] JULIANA (Tender, Safe): "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."
[L095 109.0-111.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the room with quiet hope in her blue eyes.
[L096 111.5-115.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the crackling flames and glowing embers of the fireplace, slowly fading to black as the music swells warmly.
[L097 111.5-115.0] SFX: Warm hearth crackles blending with gentle string music fading out.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
